capabilities: Convert tagged dangling wikilinks or whole lines into entity notes with frontmatter
Create notes in configurable per-type folders with configurable YAML field names
Define custom entity types with trigger tags, colors, and frontmatter templates
Decorate every wikilink to an entity note with a colored pill in all view modes
Trigger conversion on Enter when enabled in settings
disambiguation: Not a database or manager of entities; it only converts tagged links into notes and decorates the links with type badges.
extras: The manifest notes this plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Dangling wikilinks in Obsidian stay unresolved, and there is no built-in way to spin up a pre-filled, typed note for one with a single click while writing.

relations.evidence: Yes — it's designed to complement TaskNotes. Both plugins can be active at the same time.
Yes. Enable the "Trigger Templater on new file creation" setting in Templater and it will apply

summary: Inline converter that turns tagged dangling wikilinks or whole lines into structured Markdown notes with frontmatter and colored type pills.
